title: When prescription monitoring data must reach the Department
rule_summary: Under 105 CMR 700.012(A)(5) the information 105 CMR 700.012 requires shall be transmitted to the Department or its agent, in accordance with any procedures the Commissioner establishes, BY THE END OF THE NEXT BUSINESS DAY, and shall include data for ALL CONTROLLED SUBSTANCES DISPENSED SINCE THE PREVIOUS TRANSMISSION or report, by encrypted electronic device or electronic transmission method in a format the Commissioner approves. Under 700.012(A)(6) the Commissioner may waive that method for a pharmacy unable to submit electronically.
exam_relevance: Tests the reporting window a candidate must know once a dispensing is identified as reportable, including that a transmission carries everything dispensed since the last one.

numeric_facts.conditions: By the end of the next business day, covering all controlled substances dispensed since the previous transmission

exceptions: The Commissioner may waive the electronic transmission method for a pharmacy unable to submit by electronic means.
common_confusions: Reading the window as a calendar day rather than the end of the next business day.
Treating each dispensing as its own report rather than a batch covering everything since the previous transmission.
verification_notes: 105 CMR 700.012(A)(5) and (A)(6) read verbatim in the current official publication on 2026-09-10. Added because the GPT-FRESH-B4-SG-REPAIR-V5 audit found a section promising the additional-drug consequences without the reporting window. Independent audit still required.
